messages:
zoe_sales: Quick sync 10 ConnexEdge requested a 1hr POC: Okta SSO (SP-initiated) + SCIM group sync -> RBAC mapping, plus Dedicated pricing ballpark and domain verification. They propose Mon 11am PT.

ben_se: I can run it. Need: SP metadata, test admin, estimated users/groups, and cert rotation cadence. Will test role precedence behavior.

okta_admin: We'll provide SP metadata and a test admin. ~900 users, ~420 groups. Cert rotation quarterly. Need SCIM delta <3m for their provisioning flow.

rachel_sec: Security checklist: Hosted supports TLS+AES-256; BYOK possible via customer KMS but requires vendor questionnaire and KMS proof. Dedicated supports HSM. Ask if PII will be included in SCIM.

omar_prod: Product points: SCIM supports incremental delta + cursor paging. Default Hosted throttle 5rps; can increase on Dedicated. Group->role mapping supported; we have conflict resolution (highest_privilege / least_privilege). Domain verification via DNS TXT or email.

claire_legal: Legal: get their legal contact. I'll prepare DPA + SOC2 Type II and confirm deletion SLA and breach notice timing if they need Dedicated/EU residency.

ben_se: Draft POC runbook I'll send: 1) Exchange metadata + ACS 2) Issue scoped SCIM token 3) Upload mapping file 4) Run full sample sync (200 users) then delta tests 5) Cert rollover test + audit log check. Will include rollback (fallback to Hosted).

zoe_sales: ConnexEdge asked pricing: "If we go Dedicated in EU for compliance, what's a ballpark monthly delta at ~100M tokens?"

omar_prod: Ballpark: Hosted consumption ~ $0.0008/token -> ~ $80k/mo. Dedicated adds infra/ops premium; expect +$20-45k/mo depending on replication and commit. Finance to confirm. We can reserve a short eval slot for the POC (7-14 days).

rachel_sec: Ops note: for ~420 groups enable cursor paging and batching. Confirm Okta rate limits and token rotation policy; if rotation <30d discuss automated rekey.

okta_admin: We'll send metadata and a test admin by EOD Fri.

ben_se: Action items: I'll post runbook in #eng-sre and send invite for Mon 11am PT. Rachel/claire please share docs before then.

infra-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance Mon 09:45-10:00 PT. No expected customer impact.

zoe_sales: Locked Mon 11am PT. Thanks everyone ":tada:"
